newsitem.title: FRANCE: France sells extra 2.477 bln Ffr of BTANs.
newsitem.headline: France sells extra 2.477 bln Ffr of BTANs.

text.p: The Treasury said on Friday it sold a further 2.477 billion francs of BTANs after Thursday's auction, increasing the total nominal value of bonds sold to 20.342 billion francs.

NOTE - The Treasury originally announced it would sell 17 to 19 billion francs of BTANs in total. The total bid to cover ratio at the auction was 3.1.

Under the French system, primary dealers and central banks not only submit competitive bids at the auction, but also have the option, for a limited period after the sale, of buying some extra bonds at the average auction price.
